title: Melody
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Creative Arts and Sports; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts and Sports teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: C major melodies on the staff; sing and play on recorders.

skills.key_step: The child names the qualities of a good melody in C major: a clear shape, mostly steps with some leaps, repeated phrases, no sharps or flats, ending on C.

floor.question: Which is the top note of the ladder?

misconceptions.ask: On which note does a melody in C major end?
misconceptions.repair: Sing ending on G and on C; C sounds finished.

misconceptions.ask: Which is a quality of a good melody?
misconceptions.repair: Draw the melody's shape as a line: up, then down to C.

listen_for: To make it harder to sing
misconceptions.ask: Why repeat a phrase in a melody?
misconceptions.repair: Sing a well-known song and count its repeated phrases.

misconceptions.ask: Does a melody in C major need sharps or flats?
misconceptions.repair: Play the C scale on white keys or recorder: no sharps.

checks.question: On which note does a C major melody end?
